page_title: BRA 2-0 SRB | Brazil v Serbia 24/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Gabriel Jesus (Brazil) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Fred (Brazil) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alireza Faghani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
88' Rodrygo (Brazil) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.
88' The attendance for today's match is 88103.
87' It's time for a substitution. Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) comes on in place of Raphinha.

87' Rodrygo (Brazil) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.
86' A pass into the penalty area from Gabriel Jesus (Brazil) is intercepted by the defence.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Serbia.
84' Rodrygo (Brazil) is caught offside!
84' A quickly taken corner by Brazil.
83' It is time for a substitution. Nemanja Maksimovic (Serbia) is on for Aleksandar Mitrovic.

83' Fred (Brazil) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out of play and Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
83' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Gabriel Jesus (Brazil), but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
82' Rodrygo (Brazil) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.

81' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Casemiro (Brazil) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antony (Brazil) is coming onto the pitch as Neymar cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Richarlison will be replaced by Gabriel Jesus (Brazil).
78' Neymar (Brazil) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Rodrygo (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
75' Tite decides to make a substitution. Vinicius Junior will be replaced by Rodrygo (Brazil).
75' Substitution. Lucas Paqueta makes way for Fred (Brazil).

73' 2 - 0 Goal! Vinicius Junior plays in Richarlison (Brazil), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 2:0.
72' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' The ball falls to Darko Lazovic (Serbia) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Brazil will have a goal kick.
71' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia).
70' Corner kick. Dusan Tadic (Serbia) is ready to send the ball into the box.
70' Thiago Silva (Brazil) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

69' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brazil will have a goal kick.
69' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) takes the corner.
69' Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Serbia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

67' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.
66' Dragan Stojkovic prepares a substitution. Filip Mladenovic is replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Serbia).
66' That will be all from Sasa Lukic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Darko Lazovic (Serbia).
64' A yellow card for bad language! Sasa Lukic (Serbia) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
62' 1 - 0 Vinicius Junior fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Richarlison (Brazil) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.

62' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic leaps like a salmon to deny him.

60' Good touch by Alex Sandro (Brazil) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
60' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) jumps into a tackle and Alireza Faghani signals a foul.
58' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

58' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Serbia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' Dragan Stojkovic has decided to make a change. Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia) replaces Andrija Zivkovic.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ivan Ilic (Serbia) comes onto the pitch so that Nemanja Gudelj can be given a rest.
57' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alireza Faghani blows his whistle for a foul.

55' Neymar (Brazil) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.
54' A lofted cross from Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' Raphinha (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Serbia.
51' Neymar (Brazil) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

50' Neymar (Brazil) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Brazil can continue in their attacking effort.
50' A free kick from around 18 metres will be taken by someone from Brazil.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nemanja Gudelj (Serbia) was quite harsh and Alireza Faghani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) and Neymar attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' Richarlison (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

46' Excellent touch by Raphinha (Brazil)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Alireza Faghani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) plays a through ball but overhits it.
44' Raphinha (Brazil) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Serbia will have a goal kick.
42' Filip Mladenovic (Serbia) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
41' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
40' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Filip Mladenovic (Serbia) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brazil.
35' Raphinha (Brazil) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a great save.
34' Danilo (Brazil) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
34' Alex Sandro (Brazil) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
32' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Brazil can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' The corner is swung in but Brazil can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Brazil force a corner. They send men into the box.

31' Raphinha (Brazil) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Brazil win a corner.
28' Neymar (Brazil) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
28' Serbia concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Brazil have a free kick.
28' Thiago Silva (Brazil) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
26' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
24' Neymar (Brazil) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
21' Casemiro (Brazil) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to it.
21' Neymar (Brazil) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
18' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Brazil will take a throw-in.
17' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' Alireza Faghani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alex Sandro (Brazil).
14' Neymar (Brazil) takes the corner kick, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reads it well and stops the effort.
13' Neymar (Brazil) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Brazil.

13' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brazil.
11' Alireza Faghani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Paqueta (Brazil).
11' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) sends a cross into the box, but Alisson comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Neymar (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' The ball is cleared after Filip Mladenovic (Serbia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Serbia will take a throw-in.
8' Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
6' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raphinha (Brazil).
2' Raphinha (Brazil) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alireza Faghani blows for a foul.
1' The game is interrupted. Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Brazil will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alireza Faghani.
